data.raw_text:
Been an ELF since my high school days — I still remember spending my savings just to watch Super Junior’s short clips back then 🥹💙 From “Sorry Sorry” era, Leeteuk’s letters from enlistment, Yesung’s heartfelt vocals, Heechul’s struggles but never giving up, to Kyuhyun’s comeback after his accident — I grew up with their journey.
Super Show 10 in Manila hit different. Seeing them celebrate 20 years and watching Heechul smile and perform again… I couldn’t hold my tears. 🥺💙
Now, being an AHOF fan, I’m reminded of the same warmth — that deep connection between artist and fan. Different eras, same heart. 💫 Once an ELF, always an ELF. And as an AHOF today, I’ll keep cheering for the ones who make my heart feel alive. 💙✨ @SJofficial #SuperShow10Manila #ELFforever @AHOF_official
